advisory.title: Advisory Mode
advisory.description: Suitable for most users' first run. It exposes issues without turning the run into a hard gate.
bullets: Recommended as default for first run
advisory.footnote: Use this when you want signals and suggestions before tightening policy.

strict.title: Strict Mode
strict.description: Use this when results need to behave more like release or governance gates.
bullets: Better once you understand the repo structure
Useful before approving Repair or Replay
strict.footnote: Choose this when you want warnings or blocks to carry stronger operational meaning.

full.title: Full repository
full.description: Evaluate the entire project. Usually the safer choice while the platform is still learning the codebase shape.
bullets: Better posture for the first run
Recommended when you're not sure what changed
full.footnote: Safest default when you want a wider baseline first.

delta.title: Changed files only
delta.description: Focus only on a known set of changed files for faster feedback.
bullets: Better suited after the first baseline run
delta.footnote: Only recommended when you can clearly specify which files to focus on.

tokenDescriptions.ready: This module slice has the inputs needed for validation.
tokenDescriptions.partial: Only partial signals are available, so this should not be read as full coverage.
tokenDescriptions.missing: The platform did not receive source or records for this module slice.
tokenDescriptions.degraded: The stage produced a result, but evidence is incomplete or execution was limited.
tokenDescriptions.executed: The platform actually started and recorded command execution.
tokenDescriptions.not_executed: No command ran, usually because no command was selected or prerequisites were missing.

tokenDescriptions.command_execution_unavailable: No executable validation command is available for this slice, or the executor is unavailable.
tokenDescriptions.execution_signals_ready: Structured execution signals were generated and can be used to interpret this stage.
tokenDescriptions.validation_command_failed: The selected validation command failed; inspect logs and exit code for the cause.
tokenDescriptions.validation_command_timed_out: The selected validation command exceeded the timeout and must not be treated as passing.
tokenDescriptions.no_test_entrypoint_detected: No directly runnable test entrypoint was detected in the source.

tokenDescriptions.module_slice_missing: This stage has no corresponding module-slice data.
tokenDescriptions.execution_signals_unavailable: No structured execution signals are available for this stage.
tokenDescriptions.insufficient_source_signals: Source, manifest and test clues were too limited to form reliable validation signals.
tokenDescriptions.module_slice_readiness_gap: Module-slice inputs are incomplete; do not treat the result as full executable evidence.
tokenDescriptions.source_backed: This result is backed by source index or source-file evidence.

tokenDescriptions.deferred_evidence_present: Some evidence was deferred; final conclusions must disclose what did not run or was deferred.

tokenDescriptions.module_tree_walk_failed: Walking the module directory failed, so coverage and test discovery are incomplete.
